authority: Prototype Scrutiny Model (Based on AICTE Approval Process Handbook Guidelines)
description: Illustrative prototype validation rules modeled on AICTE Approval Process Handbook (APH) provisions for demonstration and verification testing.

rules.title: Clear Land Title & Ownership (Prototype Rule)
rules.condition: Land title deed must establish contiguous ownership in the name of the Trust/Society/Institution without encumbrance.
rules.sourceRef: Modeled on AICTE APH 2024-27 Chapter I, Clause 1.4 (Illustrative Prototype Rule)

rules.title: Valid Fire and Life Safety Certificate (Prototype Rule)
rules.condition: Fire & Life Safety NOC issued by the Competent Authority must remain valid throughout the active academic session.
rules.sourceRef: Modeled on AICTE APH 2024-27 Chapter I, Clause 1.8 (Illustrative Prototype Rule)

rules.title: Building Occupancy / Completion Certificate (Prototype Rule)
rules.condition: Valid occupancy certificate issued by municipal/local planning authority is mandatory prior to conducting approved technical programs.
rules.sourceRef: Modeled on AICTE APH 2024-27 Chapter II, Clause 2.3 (Illustrative Prototype Rule)

rules.title: Faculty Cadre & Student-Teacher Ratio (Prototype Rule)
rules.condition: Faculty-to-student ratio must not exceed 1:20 in Engineering & Technology degree courses, adhering to 1:2:6 cadre ratio (Prof : Assoc Prof : Asst Prof).
rules.sourceRef: Modeled on AICTE APH 2024-27 Chapter VII, Table 7.1 (Illustrative Prototype Rule)

rules.title: Prohibition of Cross-Institutional Faculty Duplication (Prototype Rule)
rules.condition: A faculty member identified by unique statutory identifier (UID/PAN/Aadhaar) cannot be claimed on the active full-time roster of more than one approved institution.
rules.sourceRef: Modeled on AICTE APH 2024-27 Norms for Faculty Authentication (Illustrative Prototype Rule)
